normalStorage.scope: Normal prefs hash before all QA phases; normal native data baseline after isolated write/read, before remaining phases. QA uses a distinct identifier and explicit paths.

limitations: New keyboard/mouse input not retested; existing keyboard acceptance retained.
Full web settings, mode/resolution, language, key rebinding and combat progress storage are outside scope.
Normal release built with original identity; existing user windows preserved.
